<p class="cna-news-lead">The CNA group has the pleasure to welcome Luna de Souter to the team.</p>
<p>Luna de Souter has joined the CNA group from KU Leuven, Belgium. She has a Bachelor of Philosophy and a Master of Statistics, and she will pursue a PhD in the field of causal inference and modeling under the supervision of Michael Baumgartner.</p>
